description: Draft the candidate's answers to an application form's open questions ("Why do you want to work here?", "Describe a project you led"), from their résumé, the notes they asked an agent to keep (for a connection that may read them) and the posting, one per question in order. Each answer lists what it rests on (context_note when it drew on a note), and needs_candidate marks one that needs a fact only they have. Self-identification, salary, visa, ID and password questions are never answered. Give the questions as the form prints them (up to 15) and exactly one of job_id, application_id, or job_description with company and role. It uses the candidate's monthly writing allowance. Give the answers to the candidate as written, to paste into the form.
name: draft_answers
title: Draft answers to a form's open questions
